```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

if (interactive()) {
  params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(
    rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path
  )$params
}

dashboard <- read_csv(here("data/solano_dashboard.csv")) |>
  filter(
    rtype == "D" &
      districtname == params$lea |
      charter_flag == "Y" & rtype == "S" & schoolname == params$lea
  ) |>
  mutate(
    statuslevel = as_factor(statuslevel),
    # reportingyear = fct_relevel(as_factor(reportingyear), "2019"),
    studentgroup = as_factor(studentgroup),
    student_group_long = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(student_group_long),
      "All students",
      "American Indian or Alaska Native",
      "Asian",
      "Black/African American",
      "Filipino",
      "Hispanic",
      "Pacific Islander",
      "White",
      "Multiple Races/Two or more",
      "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged",
      "Homeless Youth",
      "Students with Disabilities",
      "Foster Youth",
      "English Learner",
      "Long-Term English Learner",
      "English Learners Only",
      "RFEPs Only",
      "English Only",
      "Smarter Balanced Assessment",
      "CA Alternative Assessment"
    ),
    charter_flag = if_else(is.na(charter_flag), "N", charter_flag),
    indicator = case_match(
      indicator,
      "ELA" ~ "ELA",
      "Math" ~ "Math",
      "science" ~ "Science",
      "college/career" ~ "College/ Career",
      .default = indicator
    ),
    indicator = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(indicator),
      "ELA",
      "Math",
      "ELPI",
      "absenteeism",
      "graduation",
      "suspension",
      "College/ Career",
      "Science"
    ),
    lea = if_else(charter_flag == "Y", schoolname, districtname),
    color = recode_values(color, 
    0 ~ "No Status",
    1 ~ "Red",
    2 ~ "Orange",
    3 ~ "Yellow",
    4 ~ "Green",
    5 ~ "Blue") 
  ) |>
  select(
    reportingyear,
    districtname,
    schoolname,
    student_group_long,
    priority,
    indicator,
    currnumer,
    currdenom,
    currstatus,
    color,
    change,
    changelevel,
    priority_eligible,
    indicator_eligible,
    charter_flag,
    curr_prep
  )

is_charter <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(districtname == params$lea | schoolname == params$lea) |>
  pull(charter_flag) |>
  nth(1)

status_colors <- c(
  "lightgrey",
  "tomato",
  "orange",
  "yellow",
  "mediumseagreen",
  "dodgerblue",
  "darkgrey"
)

```


```{r generate_sentence}
#| include: false

library(glue)
library(stringr)

# Function to generate the string for a specific year
get_da_eligibility_text <- function(df, target_year) {
  year_data <- df |>
    filter(reportingyear == target_year, indicator_eligible == TRUE) |>
    # Handle NA colors gracefully
    mutate(
      color_suffix = if_else(is.na(color), "", paste0("-", color)),
      indicator_label = paste0(indicator, color_suffix)
    )
  
  if (nrow(year_data) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Summarize by student group and priority
  group_summary <- year_data |>
    group_by(student_group_long, priority) |>
    summarize(
      indicators_combined = str_flatten(indicator_label, collapse = ", ", last = " and "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      priority_clause = glue("{indicators_combined} (Priority #{priority})")
    ) |>
    group_by(student_group_long) |>
    summarize(
      all_priorities = str_flatten(priority_clause, collapse = ", ", last = " and "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      final_clause = glue("{student_group_long} student group(s) in {all_priorities}")
    )
  
  str_flatten(group_summary$final_clause, collapse = "; and ")
}

# Assign values to variables
text_2024 <- get_da_eligibility_text(dashboard, "2024")
text_2025 <- get_da_eligibility_text(dashboard, "2025")

is_eligible_2024 <- !is.null(text_2024)
is_eligible_2025 <- !is.null(text_2025)

# Programmatically generate the exact template sentences
template_1 <- glue(
  "{params$lea} is eligible for Differentiated Assistance based on the 2024 CA Dashboard for {text_2024}. ",
  "On the 2025 CA Dashboard, it is eligible for {text_2025}."
)

template_2 <- glue(
  "Although {params$lea} is not eligible for Year 1 Differentiated Assistance based on the 2025 CA Dashboard, ",
  "the district is eligible for Year 2 DA support based the 2024 CA Dashboard. ",
  "Based on the 2024 CA Dashboard, it is eligible for {text_2024}."
)

# Decide which template to print based on eligibility logic
final_narrative <- if (is_eligible_2024 && is_eligible_2025) {
  template_1
} else if (is_eligible_2024 && !is_eligible_2025) {
  template_2
} else {
  glue("{params$lea} is not eligible for Differentiated Assistance based on the 2024 or 2025 CA Dashboards.")
}
```

